content.short: Monday Trade is a Monad-native DEX for spot, perpetuals and real-world assets.
content.description: Monday Trade combines spot trading, perpetual futures and real-world asset markets in one venue built natively for Monad. Bundling spot and perps in a single interface is largely a margin argument: collateral posted once can support positions across both rather than sitting in separate accounts.
